findings.pass_condition: All 28 attempts remain uniquely accounted and the three failure classes remain distinct.

findings.statement: The frozen census independently reconciles 28 unique attempts across 24 slots: nine eligible successes, nine oracle negatives, seven terminal policy failures, one infrastructure-censored attempt, and two harness-censored attempts. Policy, harness, and mixed-transport attribution tests remain closed by passing evidence.

findings.pass_condition: No later attempt erases a terminal predecessor or becomes best-of-N quality evidence, and all costs reconcile exactly.
findings.required_test: Replay the three registered retry-bias mutation tests.
findings.statement: Four retries and both retry-after-terminal deviations remain explicit; predecessors stay in reliability and cost, no retry yields an oracle-PASS quality selection, and mutation tests reject terminal erasure, best-of-N selection, and count-preserving cost substitution.

findings.statement: The original freeze forbids budget mutation, retry accounting reports no post-hoc expansion, and supplemental authorization preserves the source budget while locking an immutable zero-start tranche with no model or API use.

findings.pass_condition: No vote or human field affects any technical outcome or route.

findings.target: majority vote and human technical Gate use

findings.statement: The replay projection recomputes bounded decisions from classifications, slot outcomes, retry-cost controls, evidence scopes, and supplemental authorization; frozen adversarial receipts reject deletion, best-of-N, zero-imputation, cost substitution, protocol drift, and missing-precondition mutations.

findings.statement: Quality remains EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT at two balanced cases and repeat depth one; reliability is accepted only as RELIABILITY_ONLY descriptive evidence, with quality inference, superiority, and scope conflation prohibited in every replay variant.

findings.statement: Supplemental execution remains rejected: no slot is authorized, generic and terminal retries are prohibited, harness equivalence is not established, the launch is locked, and recorded model/API starts remain zero.

findings.statement: The prior replay blocker is repaired: ORIGINAL plus four identity-blind order/label variants each reproduce all seven recorded decision projections, share one independently recomputed projection hash, preserve recorded decision replay hashes and negative controls, and route only to Phase 002D with zero network, model, or API use.
